title: Birds Never Pee. Here's Why 😳
title_options: The White Part of Bird Poop Is Pee 🐦
You've Never Seen a Bird Pee 😳
seo_intro:
Why don't birds pee? Birds don't make watery urine: their waste leaves as uric acid, a white paste that comes out with the poop through one opening, the cloaca.
The white part of bird poop is the pee. It saves water and weight for flying, and the ostrich is a rare exception.
sources_text: Encyclopaedia Britannica (bird excretory system: uric acid, cloaca, no urinary bladder in most birds); Cornell Lab of Ornithology (why bird droppings are white); embryology of the bird egg (nitrogen waste stored as uric acid in the allantois); avian physiology literature on the ostrich, which expels urine separately
